new.says: Dates: After school enrollment for K-5 students at Coppin and K-2 students at Nebinger open in March for the upcoming school year.  There is a non-refundable deposit due by June 1 for newly enrolled students or July 1 for return students.  The deposit is applied to September's tuition and then renewal is on the 1st of each month after that. Cost: PT at $175/mo for 3 set days or FT at $250/mo for 4+ days Days and hours: Monday to Friday, dismissal to 5:45pm.  We operate on the SDP closure schedule. Other: We operate on-site for students who attend Fanny Jackson Coppin or George W Nebinger. In addition, we offer a 6 week summer camp at either SDP school location.
